scope: Exact stock2024 ELF, whole-program retired-PC histogram. Provider function bodies execute inside original ROI; external shared callees remain unassigned. Debug-only linked image is never executed and all102allocated sections match.
limitations: Retired instructions are not CPU cycles or accelerator array work.
Function entry counts count executed entry PCs, including any tail entry; inline helper call counts are not inferred from global callee costs.
Source categories are debug inline attribution, not separately timed regions.
Shared memcpy/libm/allocator calls may also serve post-ROI original-consumer validation. Their full program counts are not assigned to ROI.

execution.scope: Same-ELF PC histogram, original group; no code/timing instrumentation, not stock cycles

debug_closure.scope: Debug source map only, no execution. May map frozen same-ELF PC counts only if every allocated section address/size/data is identical.

stock_reference.scope: Same ELF stock providerROI; instruction category counts are not per-category cycles.
